embargoes.basis: Current or forecast ground temperature at any airport on the itinerary (from, to or through). Above 85F refused. Between 20F and 44F (below 45F) a vet acclimation letter is required; below 20F refused even with a letter. Summer city embargo May 1 - Sep 30 from/to/through LAS, PHX, PSP, TUS.
embargoes.seasonal: May 1 - September 30: no warm-blooded pets from, to or through Las Vegas (LAS), Phoenix (PHX), Palm Springs (PSP), Tucson (TUS).
embargoes.note: aa.com and aacargo.com returned 403 to fetch and curl; figures from search-result summaries of aa.com/pets.jsp and aacargo.com pages: 'will not accept any warm-blooded pets requesting to travel from, to or through any airport with ground temperatures forecasted to be higher than 85F'; 'If the temperature is below 20 degrees Fahrenheit, your pet cannot be checked even with a letter'. maxC/minC are conversions, not read. Checked pets on AA are limited to active-duty U.S. military and State Department Foreign Service (see research-pet-cargo.json).

embargoes.basis: Temperature while the animal is on the ground at any point during travel (origin, destination, connections). Certificate of Acclimation required between 20F (-7C) and 45F (7C).
embargoes.note: 'the temperature exceeds 80˚F (27˚C) or falls below 20˚F (-7˚C) while the animal is on the ground at any point during travel'; 'A Certificate of Acclimation for your pet is required ... when temperatures fall between 20˚F (-7˚C) and 45˚F (7˚C).' Delta Cargo pet shipping is restricted to military/Foreign Service (research-pet-cargo.json).

embargoes.basis: No current temperature rule found; PetSafe closed to the general public.
embargoes.note: united.com timed out (WebFetch and curl). Search summaries (petholidayclub.com, animalpassport.co, united.com JP procedures page snippet): PetSafe suspended 20 March 2018; as of September 2026 not reopened to civilians; only active-duty U.S. military, State Department Foreign Service personnel and spouses on official orders, flights between Guam (GUM) and Honolulu (HNL).

embargoes.basis: Seasonal destination embargo when summer temperatures exceed 29.5C (85F); the page names destinations and dates, not an airport-forecast check. Cold: November 1 - March 31, at 0C (32F) or below, cats and dogs under 4.5 kg (10 lb) not accepted in the baggage compartment (heavier pets still accepted). Holiday: no checked/cargo pets December 18 - January 4.
embargoes.seasonal: All year: Aruba, Belize, Cayman Islands, Curacao, Jamaica, Panama, Trinidad and Tobago. May 1 - Oct 31: Bahamas, Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico, United States (most locations), Turks and Caicos. Jul 1 - Aug 31: Greece, Israel, Italy, Mexico, Morocco. Jul 1 - Sep 30: Bermuda, China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea. Jun 1 - Sep 30: Hong Kong, India. Dec 18 - Jan 4: no pets as checked baggage or cargo.
embargoes.note: 'Because not all our aircraft are equipped with temperature controlled and ventilated baggage compartments, it may not always be possible to accommodate your pet when summer temperatures exceed 29.5°C (85°F).' Cold: 'Cats and dogs weighing less than 4.5 kg (10 lb) are not accepted in the baggage compartment' (Nov 1 - Mar 31, 0°C/32°F or below). Hong Kong appears in two windows as read. Embraer 175 carries no pets; A319/A320/A321 not recommended.

embargoes.basis: Temperature at any point of the itinerary (secondhand); stricter for brachycephalic pets.
embargoes.note: aerlingus.com returned an Imperva bot check; iagcargo.com/en/products/pets/ was read (curl) and gives no temperature figure, only 'temperature-controlled' hold and snub-nosed crates 10% larger. Figure from search summary of pettravel.com: 'will not permit the transport of live animals when temperatures at any point of the itinerary exceed 80°F (27°C) maximum or drop below 20°F (-7°C) minimum'.

embargoes.basis: Temperatures at departure or destination city (newsroom); the policy page says origin, destination or connecting airports exceeding 'certain limits' without a number.
embargoes.note: Alaska's own newsroom, 26 August 2026: pets cannot fly in cargo when temperatures are 'hotter than 85 degrees or cooler than 45 degrees in departure or destination cities.' Policy page (alaskaair.com/.../pets-in-baggage-compartment, read via curl): 'If temperatures at the origin, destination, or connecting airports exceed certain limits, Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines may decline acceptance'. No 20F figure found. Brachycephalic dogs and cats not accepted (Boxer, Mastiff (all), Bulldog, Pug, Staffordshire Bull Terrier, etc.).

embargoes.basis: Fixed seasonal destination embargo, no temperature threshold published.
embargoes.seasonal: May 15 - Oct 31: no checked pets to/from Atlanta, Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, Fort Lauderdale, Fort Myers, Houston, Las Vegas, Miami, Nashville, Orlando, Palm Springs, Phoenix, Raleigh-Durham, Sarasota, Tampa Bay, West Palm Beach (other U.S. not restricted); same window for e.g. Antigua and Barbuda, Bahamas. Year-round no checked pets: e.g. Belize, Cuba, Mexico (Huatulco, Ixtapa/Zihuatanejo and others), Costa Rica (Liberia). No pets at all to/from Barbados, Hawaii, Ireland (Dublin), Jamaica, United Kingdom. Holiday: Dec 18 - Jan 4 zero checked pets per flight (reduced Dec 15-17 and Jan 5-7).
embargoes.note: Read via curl of westjet.com/en-ca/pets: 'Pets are not accepted in checked baggage on flights to/from Atlanta, ... Tampa Bay and West Palm Beach from May 15 to October 31. Other U.S. destinations are not restricted'. 'If your destination is heat restricted year-round, your animal may be able to travel in carry-on baggage'.

fees.priceBasis: Per kennel/carrier each way; USD 35 wholly within Hawaii.
fees.restrictions: Soft-sided carrier no larger than 17 x 11 x 9.5 in (newsroom).
fees.note: 'Pet in cabin: $100 USD per kennel; $35 USD for travel wholly within the State of Hawaii' (read in page HTML via curl).

fees.priceBasis: Per kennel each way; USD 60 wholly within Hawaii; USD 100 wholly within Alaska, active-duty U.S. military or dependents on orders.
fees.restrictions: Pet + carrier up to 150 lb / 68 kg combined (heavier via Alaska Air Cargo Pet Connect). Hard carrier; no wire, soft-sided, collapsible, plastic-door or locked-door carriers; kennels over 28 in not on intra-Hawaii flights. Brachycephalic breeds refused. Acceptance cut-off 90 min before departure. A ~20 kg dog fits within the limit.
fees.note: 'accept most domesticated pets for travel in our climate-controlled baggage and cargo compartments for a fee of $200 each way per kennel.' 'The pet and carrier combined may weigh up to 150 lbs./68 kgs.'

fees.priceBasis: Per pet one-way: CAD 50-59 within Canada and the U.S.; CAD 100-118 outside Canada and the U.S. (ranges reflect taxes).
fees.restrictions: Kennel max 41 x 21.5 x 25.4 cm (16 x 8.5 x 10 in), under the seat in front.
fees.note: 'Pets in the cabin (personal item): Flights within Canada and the U.S.: $50 - $59; Flights outside of Canada and the U.S.: $100 - $118'.

fees.priceBasis: Per pet one-way: CAD 100-118 within Canada and the U.S.; CAD 200-236 outside Canada and the U.S.
fees.restrictions: Pet + kennel combined 45 kg (100 lb); kennel max 101 x 68 x 81 cm; 3 kennels per 737, 2 per 787, 1 per Dash 8. Brachycephalic breeds via WestJet Cargo. A ~20 kg dog fits within the limit. London Heathrow pets must go as manifest cargo.
fees.note: 'Pets as checked baggage: Flights within Canada and the U.S.: $100 - $118; Flights outside of Canada and the U.S.: $200 - $236'. Weight from westjet.com/en-ca/pets: 'Weight restrictions (pet + kennel combined): 45 kg (up to 100 lb.)'. Supersedes the secondhand fee status in research-pet-cargo.json.
